cases.name: manual/0
cases.intro: Tool Change detected, stay clear of the machine! Wait until initial movements are complete!

substeps.title: Safety First
substeps.description: Jog your machine to a place you can reach using the jog controls and ensure that your router/spindle is turned off and has fully stopped spinning.

substeps.title: Change Bit
substeps.description: Change over to the next tool (T12)

substeps.title: Reset the Z
substeps.description: Use jogging or X and Y gotos to bring your CNC back over to where you initially set the project zero. If you used a touch plate be sure to place the tool over the plate and attach the magnet.

substeps.title: Resume Job
substeps.description: If everything looks good, prepare for your machine to move back to the cutting area and continue as expected. Remove the touch plate magnet and turn on your router if you have them.

cases.name: semiauto/1
cases.intro: Tool Change detected, stay clear of the machine! Wait until initial movements are complete!

substeps.title: Safety First
substeps.description: Ensure that your router/spindle is turned off and has fully stopped spinning then jog your machine to your tool change location using the jog controls.

substeps.title: Change Tool
substeps.description: Change over to the next tool (T2). Once ready, jog to 0.4in above the probe location, attach the magnet, and prepare to probe

actions.label: Probe Changed Tool
lines: (Set Z to Tool offset and wait)

substeps.title: Resume Job
substeps.description: If everything looks good, prepare for your machine to move back to the cutting area and continue as expected. Remove the touch plate magnet and turn on your router if you have them.

cases.name: automatic/2
cases.intro: Tool Change detected, stay clear of the machine! Wait until initial movements are complete!

substeps.title: Change Tool
substeps.description: Ensure that your router/spindle is turned off and has fully stopped spinning, and prepare to change over to the next tool (T2).

substeps.title: Measure New Tool
substeps.description: After you've switched to the new tool (T2), click the button below to automatically probe and set the new tool's length offset.

actions.label: Probe Changed Tool
lines: (Set Z to Tool offset and wait)

substeps.title: Resume Job
substeps.description: If everything looks good, prepare for your machine to move back to the cutting area and continue as expected. Turn on your router if you have one.

cases.name: probeToolLength/3
cases.intro: Prepare to probe the initial tool length. Ensure your router/spindle is turned off and has fully stopped spinning.

substeps.title: Measure Tool Length
substeps.description: Ensure that your router/spindle is turned off and has fully stopped spinning. Click the button below to probe the length of the current tool.

substeps.title: Resume Operation
substeps.description: Tool length has been probed and set. Click the button below to continue with your operation. Turn on your router if you have one.
